_comment: Static code-entry seeds for bank $1e (reward/EXP flow) stranded handlers: bank-swap/VRAM copiers ($442b/$7065/$7a30), farcall stub ($73d7) and $6ada. Function starts only. Flat = 0x1e*0x4000 + (cpu-0x4000). The targets of the three $4000-style tables at $66f7/$6d14/$7445 were seeded here as handlers and are NOT code: $66f7 points at 25-entry EXP word tables, $6d14 at game-flag-id lists, $7445 at $ff-terminated entry-id lists (see SetRewardGameFlag/GetFirstClearRewardExp/RunRewardCategoryList, which read them as data); they are declared in data_tables.json instead.
